content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the TX path overwriting the first character in the circular buffer (`xmit->buf[0]`) with the `x_char` value when sending data. This led to the loss of any character that was already present in that position of the buffer, as the previous character was replaced without being sent. The patch removed the `pop_tx_x()` function, which was responsible for this behavior, and instead directly handled the transmission of `x_char` without affecting the contents of the circular buffer.
